As Finance Manager - Client Billing, you will be accountable for timely, accurate and compliant customer invoicing across ZS globally. You will lead a team of approximately 20-22 billing professionals, build skills and capabilities, improve efficiency through process redesign and automation, and act as a trusted partner to Finance and business leaders. This role balances operational excellence with strategic transformation.
